headings.usage: H1, H2, large manifesto numbers. Ranger-style classic elegance.

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, navigation. Modern geometric contrast.

accent.usage: Editorial marquee, elegant emphasis in titles.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse, natural shadows. hover:shadow-2xl with low opacity (#121212 at 10%). No hard generic shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders (#121212 at 15% opacity) to create grid lines and clipped frames.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (pointer-events-none) to give the digital page a physical paper/tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal rounding. Use rounded-none or very slight rounded-sm (2px) to keep the classic architectural feel.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12 to p-32 for section padding. Massive negative space around the manifesto text.
layouts.grids: Asymmetric grids. For rooms: one large col-span-8 image, one col-span-4 block of text. Clipped image frames that don't fill 100% of the container.
layouts.hero: 100vh height. Large kinetic typography, masked line-by-line reveal. Background image with 20% charcoal overlay.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for momentum and weight.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image and large gallery images.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveals for H1 and Manifesto chapters. Use overflow-hidden wrappers and y-axis translation.
motion.interactions: Hover states on room cards should slightly scale the image within a clipped frame, and reveal a mustard yellow accent border.

components.hero: Kinetic Hero with line-by-line text reveal ('THE HONEY WOODS'). Background: Manali snow mountain.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. 'MAKING LIVES WORTH LIVING — EST 2020 —'. Serif font, large text, mustard/honey accent.
components.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02). Massive numbers in Playfair Display. Overlapping clipped images.
components.rooms_showcase: Asymmetrical layout showing luxury wooden interiors. Real photography with clipped frames.
components.packages: Elegant lists for 'Manali Package'. Subtle separators.
components.booking_form: Minimalist inquiry form. Use Shadcn UI but stripped of 'tech' feel. Underlined inputs or delicate borders.
components.header: Sticky nav. Glassmorphism is banned here; use a solid #F9F9F6 background with a delicate bottom border, or completely transparent at top but transitioning to solid on scroll.

hero_background.description: Snow covered mountain for the cinematic hero section

gallery_nature.description: Misty pine forest for mood/manifesto section
Snowy mountain and trees for gallery

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a gradient overlay or text-shadow to meet APCA contrast ratios.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Godly-level editorial boutique hotel site.
Do not use Shadcn card components. Build raw custom HTML/Tailwind structures for rooms, packages, and manifesto sections.
Use framer-motion heavily for on-scroll reveals. Specifically, implement a masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 in the hero.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is non-negotiable for the premium feel.
The marquees should use 'react-fast-marquee' and feel slow, deliberate, and editorial. DO NOT make it a fast news ticker.
For the booking form, use Shadcn form components but restyle them to look like elegant, minimalist editorial inputs (e.g., just bottom borders, no full boxes).
DO NOT center everything. Use asymmetric grid alignments.
DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for headings. Use Playfair Display.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Make it creative and distinctive.
Avoid simplistic gradients and uniform styling. Use solid colors and subtle noise textures instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header over hero images unless it clearly transitions to a solid background on scroll.
Use pill-shaped or sharp-cornered buttons with interactions.
